title: Power Apps: form fill assistance suggests updates to fields that already have values
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, current licensing requirements and documented controls are supported. The corrected per-app navigation is documented across the two cited maker pages, and the briefing distinguishes today's form fill assistance from the planned suggestions for existing values.
